items.mainDefect: The newly added `_create_process_for_shard` method is dead code that is never called.

secondary.defect: If `_create_process_for_shard` were called, it would restart the owning process without killing the current one, leaving an orphaned process that flushes the same shards twice.

items.mainDefect: The docstring says the flusher creates one process per shard, but it actually creates up to max_processes processes and assigns shards to them round-robin.

secondary.defect: The docstring calls it a multiprocessing manager, but the produce_to_pipe path creates threads instead of processes.
